responsibility: Provides Motorola 68000 family common option handling focused on compatibility aliases and shared-library configuration. It maps compound CPU/tuning options like -m68020-40 and -m68020-60 onto separate backend cpu/tune fields, validates -mshared-library-id ranges and derives the corresponding library-ID string used by code generation or runtime support, and installs the M68K common target hook table for the rest of the backend.
